title: Well test register
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-6 met: a registered test belongs to exactly one well through a natural key that begins with it and may carry several analyses through each analysis's TEST_ID (SG-08-4); the test types and result codes are validated against R_WELL_TEST_TYPE and R_TEST_RESULT; a duplicate well+date+type is refused against the stored rows; a test with no result code reads as pending and never as a failure; every rate, pressure and duration carries its unit; and a test with a linked analysis cannot be deleted while one without can.

dataModel.decision: PPDM's WELL_TEST is the owner's table for the test and already carries the date, type, duration and result code, so the register does not duplicate it. What the app adds - who recorded it, the result and duration in the register's own terms, the unit-bearing rates and the remarks - lives in a new LifeCycle-owned WELL_TEST_REGISTER row that identifies its test by the PPDM natural key (UWI + TEST_TYPE + RUN_NUM + TEST_NUM), because WELL_TEST has no surrogate key for a unit of work to address. The link runs the other way: WTA-01's WELL_TEST_ANALYSIS_RESULT.TEST_ID holds the same key, so one test has several analyses and each analysis belongs to exactly one test.
tables: WELL_TEST_REGISTER (REGISTER_ID key, TEST_KEY, WELL_UWI, TEST_TYPE, RUN_NUM, TEST_NUM, TEST_DATE, DURATION, DURATION_OUOM, RESULT_CODE, PRODUCTION_METHOD, REMARKS, OIL_RATE/OUOM, GAS_RATE/OUOM, FLOWING_PRESSURE/OUOM, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT)
read: R_WELL_TEST_TYPE and R_TEST_RESULT (the codes), WELL_TEST_ANALYSIS_RESULT (the link)
dataModel.registration: WELL_TEST_REGISTER was added to LifeCycleModule's entity list rather than creating a 34th module, because LifeCycle already owns this domain. --smoke now reports 33 modules and 410 entity types (up from 33 and 409).

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/WellTest/OgWellTestRegister.cs (OgWellTestSummary, OgWellTestEntry, OgWellTestRegisterWorkspace, WellTestRegisterRules, IOgWellTestRegister, OgWellTestRegisterService with LoadAsync/SaveAsync/DeleteAsync)
implementation.link: The register's TEST_KEY is UWI|TEST_TYPE|RUN_NUM|TEST_NUM; it is stored on the register row and matched against each analysis's TEST_ID, so a test's analysis count is a count of analyses pointing at it.
implementation.codes: The type and result lists are read from R_WELL_TEST_TYPE and R_TEST_RESULT (active rows only) every time the workspace loads - the feature's open question about R_TEST_RESULT content is answered by reading it, and an empty table refuses registration with 'seed the reference table first' rather than accepting any code.
implementation.duplicate: A second test for the same well, date and type is refused naming the date and the existing register id; an edit of the same row is not a duplicate.
implementation.delete: DeleteAsync counts the analyses linked to the test first and refuses while any exist, naming the count.
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/WellTestRegisterPageView.cs (route 'welltestregister': the identify/run/result/conditions bars, the registered-tests grid, the selected-test summary and an edit action that keeps the same row)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgWellTestRegister), OgApplication.WellTestRegister, catalog 'welltestregister' (OgModuleKeys.Wells), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/WellTestRegisterTests.cs (7, no database) + WellTestRegisterGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with R_WELL_TEST_TYPE, R_TEST_RESULT, WELL_TEST_REGISTER and a minimal WELL_TEST_ANALYSIS_RESULT, seeded in WellTestRegisterGatewayTests
integration.ac1_one_well: a registered test stores WELL_UWI='WELL-1' with TEST_KEY='WELL-1|BUILDUP|1|1'; the same row is found by the key, and the key changes when the well or the type changes, so a test cannot belong to two wells. This is SG-08-4's first half.
integration.ac1_several_analyses: linking one analysis row whose TEST_ID is the test key makes the register read HasAnalysis true with a count of 1, and the count is derived from the analyses rather than stored - so a second analysis would read 2.
integration.ac2_codes: the workspace offers BUILDUP and DRAWDOWN from R_WELL_TEST_TYPE and FAILED and OK from R_TEST_RESULT; 'ISOCHRONAL' is refused naming the reference table and writing nothing
integration.ac3_duplicate: a second BUILDUP for the same well and date is refused with welltest-register-duplicate naming the date and leaving the row count at 1; a DRAWDOWN on the same date is accepted
integration.ac4_pending: a test with no result code reads StatusText 'pending result' and PendingResult true, and the stored RESULT_CODE is null; a test with a code reads the code and its reference long name
integration.ac5_units: the row stores OIL_RATE 1200 with OIL_RATE_OUOM bbl/d, GAS_RATE 900 with Mscf/d, FLOWING_PRESSURE 2400 with psia and DURATION 24 with h, and the page prints each with its unit; a value without a unit is refused
integration.ac6_delete: deleting the test that has an analysis is refused with welltest-register-analysis-linked and leaves both rows; deleting the analysis-free test succeeds and the row is gone
integration.unavailable: dropping the register table makes LoadAsync return a workspace with HistoryFailed true

gates.AC-1 A test links to exactly one well an: pass - the natural key begins with the well and the register holds one WELL_UWI; the analysis count is read from the analyses whose TEST_ID is that key, so the multiplicity is on the analysis side. SG-08-4.
gates.AC-2 Test type and result codes come fro: pass - both lists are read from R_WELL_TEST_TYPE and R_TEST_RESULT on every load, an unknown code is refused naming the table, and an empty table refuses with the instruction to seed it.
gates.AC-3 A duplicate well+date+type is refus: pass - refused against the stored rows with the date and the existing id named, while a different type on the same date is accepted and an edit of the same row is not treated as a duplicate.
gates.AC-4 Pending result is distinct from fai: pass - an absent or blank code is 'pending result' and never contains the word fail; a recorded code is shown with the reference long name, so a failure is expressed by the code itself.
gates.AC-5 Rates and pressures carry units: pass - the row stores each value with its OUOM and the page prints each with its unit; a value without a unit, or a duration without one of h/min/d, is refused.
gates.AC-6 Deleting a test with analyses is re: pass - the delete counts the linked analyses first and refuses naming them, and the unanalysed test deletes cleanly.

limits: The register reads its reference codes from R_WELL_TEST_TYPE and R_TEST_RESULT as the feature asks; this repository's PPDM seeders supply them, and the gateway test seeds them by hand, so an unseeded database cannot register a test.

The PPDM WELL_TEST table itself is not written by this feature: the register row is the app's record, joined to WELL_TEST by the natural key. A test imported into PPDM without a register row does not appear on this screen until it is registered, and the screen says 'No well test is registered yet.' rather than showing a partial list.
Results are joined by TEST_KEY, so an analysis that predates this feature (its TEST_ID empty or holding another form of id) is not counted; the count reflects the link this feature establishes.
CSV import of tests (the plan's DAT-06 profile) is not built; the register is entered on the page.
The feature's permissions (welltest.register.write/.delete) are not enforced per command: the app gates pages.
WTA-03 (pipeline analysis and integrity) is still not started, so STG-08 is not complete.
